name: Retatrutide
class: GLP-1 / GIP / glucagon triple receptor agonist

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: An investigational triple agonist at the GLP-1, GIP and glucagon receptors, studied for obesity and type 2 diabetes. No marketing authorisation exists in any jurisdiction; all human data come from clinical trials.

systems.note: Incretin receptor agonism at GLP-1 and GIP; the intended metabolic target.
Trial weight loss is large and includes a lean-mass component.
Glucagon receptor agonism raises heart rate in trials.
Rapid hepatic fat mobilisation moves the transaminase reading independently of any injury.

monitors.why: Glycaemic effect of the incretin components.
Trial weight loss is not fat-selective.
Hepatic fat mobilisation and the absence of a marketed safety record.
